prompt:

Quiet introspective mature silhouette, simple face with no identifiable portrait, full body seen from front. Vintage archival hand-cut printed paper, warm cream paper edges, fine sepia halftone, elegant album artwork. No text, labels, watermark, extra limbs or photographic human skin. Genuinely transparent alpha background, no checkerboard texture. Feet and entire silhouette visible.
